submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "My Toddler Wants to Be Carried and I Physically Can't"
finding.problem: "My son cries 'carry me' and I have to say no while holding the baby I CAN carry. He thinks I don't love him. My heart is breaking and my scar is burning."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 33-yr-old Nigerian mom, 2-yr-old + newborn via repeat CS; toddler jealous, demands "mummy carry," she's forbidden to lift >baby weight.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (CS mom + older sibling survival) + cross-sell to "Baby + Older Children" market.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
